status: built and simulated; NOTHING WAS SENT
environment: Optimism mainnet (chain id 10) through the pinned read-only chain helper

signer.mode: sequential (one transaction per signer call; works on any signer, atomic or not)
signer.nonce_pinning: read from setup.deep-r3-trade.json by the executor, never inferred

base.note: no step compares block numbers or hashes between reads: validity at each send rests on the nonce (latest == pending == nonce_expected), the per-market pin, the drift report, each call's floor and the pre-send re-check (G section 8, The head moves)

mint.note: parent split by M (none when M = 0), then each middle with a position by m_X = M + b_X (none when m_X = 0); no zero split emitted; the mint is not re-sized

ordering: mint-parent, mint-middle A, B, C (those emitted), then the trade groups in allocation order, each market's set group ahead of its UP/DOWN rows; every group is an ordered sequence of single transactions, sent one at a time in nonce order

drift.note: G section 8, The head moves: a moved pool is reported, never stale by itself; each call carries its own floor and the pre-send re-check decides

simulation.helper_subcommand: simulate (groups form, one blockStateCalls entry per keep-whole group)
simulation.gas_limit_rule: ceil(maxUsedGas x 1.2), clamped at 16777216; ceil(gasUsed x 1.5) for a call the RPC gave no maxUsedGas (G section 8, Gas limits); copied from the helper, never computed by hand
simulation.note: one request: the whole ordered sequence

eth_funding.affordability_rule: before each keep-whole group: ETH >= 0.002 ETH + the sum over the group of gas_limit x 2 x eth_gasPrice (G section 8, Affordability); the executor makes this check fresh before each group; this walk is a projection
eth_funding.l1_data_fee_source: GasPriceOracle.getL1Fee(unsigned type-2 transaction) read through the helper multicall for every transaction (0x420...000F)
eth_funding.price_sources: QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle(WETH, USDC, 1e18, fee 500) and PSM3.previewSwapExactIn(sUSDS, USDS, 1e18), read through the helper; sUSDS is not a dollar (I-setup.md I.1 section 6)

scenarios.scenario: effective price = eth_gasPrice (what the node suggests)
effective price = the signer's ceiling maxFeePerGas = 2 x eth_gasPrice

totals.unit_note: M sUSDS is minted into independent per-market repo-token budgets; every per-market number is in that market's repo token; sUSDS equivalent at the labelled 1/N = 1/98 (0 if the repo is not evaluated)

end_state_check.method: each simulate window re-run with one final group of flagged balanceOf calls, 20 per request; a difference is recorded, never hidden (the pools may have moved since the build)

verification.boundary_at_build: 69 of 69 children clear at block 158832899 (timestamp 1793264575); parent and 3 middles payoutDenominator 0/0/0/0

indep.reason: skipped: the independent second-RPC read is supervised-only (the chain helper pins one RPC and the planner contacts none itself); pass --indep in a supervised session to write the request

send_time_duties: before every group: the trading-boundary read and fresh slot0 of the market (G section 3); a flip makes the plan stale
before every group: the affordability gate, ETH >= 0.002 ETH + the sum over the group of gas_limit x 2 x eth_gasPrice (G section 8, Affordability)
before every transaction: the holder nonce latest == pending == nonce_expected; the signer-input file equal to the plan (calldata, to, gasLimit) and its keccak256 equal to calldata_keccak256

before every transaction: the signer's own simulate passes, and the pre-send gas check holds: gas_limit >= the fresh gas_used x 1.2, gas_limit >= the peak this plan measured (max_used_gas, else gas_used), and the fresh gas_used at most 10% above this plan's (G section 8)
before every swap: its floor (amountOutMinimum) or bound (amountInMaximum) against a fresh quote

write inflight.json and the nonce attempt before every broadcast; one call per send, never re-run once it printed its broadcast line (G section 8; a throttle answered before signing is re-run: I-setup.md I.2 section 7, Rate limits)
before a merge-arb group: its child Invalid read fresh at the holder; below q the plan is stale (G section 1)
rebuild the last two transactions of every complex-buy after the sale's receipt, with P = the realised proceeds and a fresh quote at P (rebuild_at_send, G section 3)
a revert, a floor breach or a stale check stops sending; the group in progress goes to the recovery rule, the groups not started are skipped (G section 8 step 4)
